name: International Stable Currency
oneLiner: ISC is a purchasing-power token tracking a basket of physical gold, investment-grade bonds, T-bills, global equities, and cash; price appreciates over time.
collateral: Basket of real-world assets (gold, bonds, T-bills, equity, cash)
pegMechanism: RWA-indexed basket tracking purchasing power; price appreciates over time

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: ISC has a single Solana deployment in the reviewed metadata and no sourced bridge, lockbox, or cross-chain route was resolved. Pharos treats this secondary-triage row as single-chain/native.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: ISC's Solana mint has a non-null freeze authority, and Solana token accounts can be frozen when a mint retains freeze authority. That is direct holder-account freeze capability.

mintAuthority.summary: ISC is a Solana SPL token whose mint authority is a 2-of-3 SPL Token multisig (3XM6WqYLx5gKpRNwnCcUrBmJAhRHx3imktwEvbRwXavZ) controlled by the ISC team via three keypairs; the same address is the freeze authority. New ISC is created against assets deposited into the ISC Reserve.

controls.label: ISC SPL 2-of-3 mint multisig

review.evidence: At Solana slot ~405,000,000 (2026-06-11), getAccountInfo on mint J9BcrQfX4p9D1bvLzRNCbMDv8f44a9LFdeqNE4Yk2WMD returned mintAuthority and freezeAuthority both set to 3XM6WqYLx5gKpRNwnCcUrBmJAhRHx3imktwEvbRwXavZ. That account is a type=multisig SPL Token account with numRequiredSigners=2, numValidSigners=3, and three system-program-owned keypair signers (B6PG7..., FUPe37..., 3kHz9...). This is a 2-of-3 ISC team multisig with no on-chain program guard. No permissionless mint route exists.
